name: model-trader
readme_summary: model-trader is a Python framework that transforms a trader's recorded thinking (from videos, articles, etc.) into an executable algorithmic trading strategy. It distills their judgment into a series of pass/fail checks, enabling the creation of live screeners and paper traders, with an optional LLM agent to provide discretionary oversight.
key_features: Distill trader's recorded thinking into executable strategy
Create live screeners and paper traders
Optional LLM agent for discretionary review
JSON-journaled paper trader with risk controls
CLI tools for pipeline automation (transcript fetching, strategy extraction)
primary_use_case: To automate and codify the trading strategies of human traders by translating their qualitative decision-making processes into quantitative, executable code.
cover_image_prompt: A seasoned cartographer meticulously drawing a complex treasure map on an ancient desk. Instead of islands and seas, the map depicts interconnected nodes representing trading patterns and decision points, with clear 'pass' and 'fail' markers. Flowing from the map are digital streams of data leading to a small, stylized trading terminal on the side, actively executing trades. Subtle glowing lines connect the cartographer's thoughts (represented by floating abstract shapes) to the map's creation. The overall mood is one of insightful translation and automated execution. The style should be a detailed digital painting with a warm, focused lighting.

name: another
description: A desktop app for mirroring and controlling Android devices over USB. Built with Tauri, React, and Rust.
readme_summary: Another is a desktop application that allows users to mirror and control their Android devices on their computer via USB or Wi-Fi. It leverages scrcpy for streaming and input, offering features like screen recording, macro recording, and AI agent integration through an MCP server.
key_features: MCP Server for AI agent control
primary_use_case: Mirroring and controlling an Android device from a desktop computer, with advanced features for automation and AI integration.
cover_image_prompt: A split scene: on one side, a detailed, realistic Android phone screen displaying a complex app interface. On the other side, a clean, modern desktop computer monitor showing a mirrored, interactive version of the phone screen. A glowing digital bridge, formed by lines of code and data streams, connects the phone to the monitor, symbolizing the seamless mirroring and control. Subtle UI elements of 'Another' app are visible on the monitor. The overall mood is efficient and futuristic, with a cool blue and green color palette. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear visual connection and data flow.

name: Text-Grab
description: Use OCR in Windows quickly and easily with Text Grab. With optional background process and notifications.
readme_summary: Text Grab is a Windows application that uses Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to extract text from images, PDFs, and screen regions. It offers multiple capture modes, on-device processing for privacy, and integration with the Windows environment for quick text copying and editing.
key_features: OCR text extraction from screen regions, images, and PDFs
On-device processing for privacy and no internet dependency
Multiple capture modes (Full-Screen, Region, Window, File)
Clipboard output and direct editor integration
Optional Windows AI features for enhanced accuracy on Copilot+ PCs
primary_use_case: Extracting and copying text from any visible source on Windows, especially from images or areas where text cannot be selected directly.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized robot hand gently plucking glowing letters from a complex, abstract image of a digital landscape. The robot hand is holding a magnifying glass that reveals the extracted letters clearly. Beside the robot, a simple, clean interface window shows the text neatly organized. Subtle digital particles flow from the image to the interface, representing the OCR process. The background is a soft, blurred cityscape of Windows icons. The overall mood is helpful and efficient, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with vibrant, friendly colors and clear, readable elements.

name: HuggingFaceModelDownloader
description: Simple go utility to download HuggingFace Models and Datasets
readme_summary: HuggingFaceModelDownloader is a Go utility designed for efficiently downloading models and datasets from the HuggingFace Hub. It offers parallel download capabilities, an interactive GGUF analyzer for selecting model quantizations, and seamless integration with Python's HuggingFace libraries.
key_features: Parallel downloads (multiple connections per file, concurrent file downloads)
Interactive GGUF picker with quality ratings and RAM estimates
Full proxy support (SOCKS5, authentication, CIDR bypass)
primary_use_case: Downloading models and datasets from HuggingFace Hub, with a focus on efficient, parallel downloads and intelligent selection of model quantizations.
cover_image_prompt: A powerful, stylized robotic arm in a clean, modern workshop, efficiently grabbing and sorting various sized boxes labeled with AI model names (like 'LLM', 'Vision', 'Audio'). The arm is simultaneously picking multiple boxes from a large, organized digital shelf representing the HuggingFace Hub. Below, a smaller, friendly robot is meticulously analyzing a holographic projection of a GGUF file, showing star ratings and RAM usage. Subtle glowing data streams connect the arm and the analyzer, with the repository name 'HuggingFace Downloader' subtly etched on the robotic arm. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with a bright, optimistic color palette and clear, defined shapes.
